policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: W-7 tests PROTAC crystallization in microgravity
items.summary: V launched W-7 to test microgravity effects on PROTAC solubility by enabling different crystal forms; V framed results as potentially unlocking better formulation paths for clinical use.

items.headline: GPT-6 rollout with Intelligent UI expands
items.summary: O announced global rollout of GPT-6 in ChatGPT with “Intelligent UI,” adding faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences for users and builders.

items.headline: Fundraising acceleration ahead of comps
items.summary: Reporting says O pushed faster fundraising meetings to lock capital before broader investor comparisons tied to Anthropic’s IPO window, with discussions focused on growth and valuation positioning.

items.headline: Math releases continue with community funding
items.summary: O published an update on sharing AI progress in mathematics and said it will fund workshops/conferences and continue improving release quality for the math community.

items.headline: V operates multiple spacecraft; more launches pending
items.summary: Coverage says V had two spacecraft operating in orbit and planned additional launches “in the coming days,” supporting throughput and milestone cadence for in-space manufacturing.

items.headline: Series D funds orbital drug manufacturing scaling
items.summary: Reporting indicates V raised about $250M (Series D) at a ~$1.6B valuation to scale in-orbit pharmaceutical manufacturing and advance toward first medicines.

items.headline: Model deprecations signal shifting product roadmap
items.summary: GroqDocs listed deprecations for `G/compound` and `G/compound-mini` scheduled for September 21, 2026, implying migration needs for developers relying on these models.
